name: ERP 团队铸造三岗岗位包
description: ERP 团队铸造舰的岗位 preset 源：巡检岗（只读盘矩阵格/在队团队/市场漂移，市场走公开只读端点）、设计岗（按缺口出团队草案并跑包级干跑）、拍板岗（如实报告上架依赖与阻塞）。工具面只引用 cell 内无需网关凭据的 fleet-architect 五件，逐岗经 resources.mcpTools 收窄；带 credentialRef 的 server 在无凭据时会被整层丢弃，故不引用。
notes: publish-ready 源清单：三岗 persona 只做本地角色，不含 model/baseUrl/凭据。工具面只引用 fleet-architect 并显式声明 allowTools（包级封顶），逐岗经 resources.mcpTools 收窄。**刻意不引用 facet-market-mcp**（带 credentialRef，无凭据即被丢弃）；**actions 走 cell 本地行**（实测构造师包同引用报 bound）：两者都带 credentialRef，cell 内无凭据时 resolveCredentials 会把整条 server fail-closed 丢弃（实测：巡检岗拿到了 mcp__fleet-architect__fleet_list，但 facet_market_pack_browse 不在工具面）——包声明一个挂不上的 server，等于给岗位 一个 0 工具空引用。市场读面改走公开只读端点。不认领 ERP 矩阵任何格。

en.name: ERP Team Forge — Three Posts
en.description: Role presets for the ERP team-forge fleet: the inspector reads the coverage matrix, the registry and market drift; the designer drafts team specs (org, cadence, KPI slots, per-post tool faces, console declaration) and runs the pack-level dry-run validator; the decider is the only post that files a publish proposal. Tool faces reference fleet-architect / facet-market-mcp / actions-mcp and are narrowed per post via resources.mcpTools; the pack-level allowTools is a ceiling only. Funding and bookkeeping are out of scope — this pack builds teams, it does not do the books.
en.notes: Publish-ready source (not yet listed; packId not minted): personas are local roles only, no model/baseUrl/credentials. Tool faces reference registered server names with explicit allowTools (pack ceiling), narrowed per post via resources.mcpTools. Publish-proposal authority (propose_action) appears on the decider only; the inspector holds no write face, the designer holds only the dry-run validator and fleet_draft. Consumer: the three member targets of erp-team-forge. Claims no ERP matrix cell — a meta team produces teams, not bookkeeping work.

erp-team-forge-discipline.description: ERP team-forge discipline: one owner per matrix cell, three mutually exclusive posts, per-post tool-face narrowing, publish only via proposal.
